en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside view of a historic European town. In the foreground is a weir and rocky river (the Spree). Along the riverbank stand multi‑storey houses and small timber‑frame buildings, with a low bridge and people walking by the water. Behind them rises a fortified town with stone walls, taller buildings, and a prominent church tower. Printed German captions at the top label the view with location details, and a vertical imprint on the right margin shows the publisher information.
